dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: Right? I custom-made every single one of these darts and boards. Beautiful, aren't they? I hunted down rare materials from all over the world just to craft them.

dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: A sturdier tip, a perfectly balanced barrel, and a board carved by my own two hands. Every time I upgrade my gear, I wish for a higher score...

dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: It's sad that my score just refuses to budge... So, I have no choice but to completely rework my setup all over again.

dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: ...What drives me absolutely crazy is that some people can just walk up with some cheap darts from a street vendor and effortlessly land a higher score than me! It's just so frustrating!
